verses.text: Jesus called his twelve disciples together and gave them authority over unclean spirits—to drive them out and heal every disease and sickness.
Here are the names of the twelve apostles: first, Simon, called Peter, and his brother Andrew; James, Zebedee’s son, and his brother John;
Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, also called Thaddaeus;
Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, the one who betrayed Jesus.
Jesus sent these twelve out with instructions: “Don’t go to Gentile territory or enter a Samaritan city.”
“Go instead to the lost sheep of Israel’s people.”
“As you go, preach this message: ‘Heaven’s Kingdom is right here!’”
“Heal the sick, cleanse people with leprosy, drive out demons. You received freely, so give freely.”
“Don’t pack gold, silver, or copper in your money belts.”
“Don’t take a travel bag, an extra shirt, sandals, or a walking stick. A worker deserves their food.”
“When you enter a town or village, find someone there who’s worthy and stay at their home until you move on.”
“As you enter the home, greet the household.”
“If the household is worthy, let your peace rest on it. If it isn’t, let your peace return to you.”
“If anyone won’t welcome you or listen to your words, leave that house or town and shake its dust off your feet.”
“I’m telling you the truth: judgment day will go easier for Sodom and Gomorrah than for that town.”
“Look, I’m sending you out like sheep among wolves. So be wise as snakes and innocent as doves. 🐍🕊️”
“Watch out for people. They’ll hand you over to councils and whip you in their synagogues.”
“You’ll be brought before governors and kings because of me, to testify to them and to the nations.”
“When they hand you over, don’t stress about what to say or how to say it. At that moment, you’ll be given the words.”
“It won’t be you speaking; it’ll be your Father’s Spirit speaking through you.”
“A brother will hand over his brother to be killed, and a father his child. Children will turn against their parents and have them put to death.”
“Everyone will hate you because of my name, but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.”
“When they persecute you in one town, run to the next. I’m telling you the truth: you won’t finish going through Israel’s towns before the Son of Man comes.”
“A disciple doesn’t outrank their teacher, and a servant doesn’t outrank their master.”
“It’s enough for a disciple to become like their teacher, and a servant like their master. If they called the head of the house Beelzebul, they’ll say worse about the rest of the household.”
“So don’t be afraid of them. Nothing covered up will stay hidden; what’s concealed will be brought into the open.”
“What I tell you in the dark, speak in the light. What you hear whispered, announce from the rooftops.”
“Don’t fear people who can kill the body but can’t kill the soul. Fear the One who can destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.”
“Aren’t two sparrows sold for one small coin? Yet not one falls to the ground outside your Father’s care.”
“Even the hairs on your head are all counted.”
“So don’t be afraid. You’re worth more than many sparrows.”
“Everyone who acknowledges me in front of people, I’ll acknowledge in front of my Father in heaven.”
“But whoever disowns me in front of people, I’ll disown in front of my Father in heaven.”
“Don’t think I came to bring peace to earth. I didn’t come to bring peace, but a sword.”
“I came to set a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”
“A person’s enemies will be right inside their own household.”
“Anyone who loves their father or mother more than me isn’t worthy of me. Anyone who loves their son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.”
“Anyone who won’t take up their cross and follow me isn’t worthy of me.”
“Whoever clings to their life will lose it; whoever loses their life for my sake will find it.”
“Whoever welcomes you welcomes me, and whoever welcomes me welcomes the One who sent me.”
“Whoever welcomes a prophet because he’s a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. Whoever welcomes a righteous person because they’re righteous will receive a righteous person’s reward.”
“I’m telling you the truth: whoever gives even one of these little ones a cup of cold water because they’re my disciple will absolutely not lose their reward.”
